# Research

::: sub
**Quantitative Ecology · Conservation Bioacoustics · Ornithology**

## **Passive acoustic monitoring of urban bird communities.**
:::

I currently study how bird communities respond to development across an
urban gradient in Stockton, a city in California’s Central Valley. Using
passive acoustic monitoring and automated species identification, I am
modeling how occupancy and relative abundance vary with vegetation
structure.

The Valley has lost more than 90% of its historic wetlands, riparian
forests, and grasslands. Habitat-specialist birds have declined with
them. Because this region forms a large part of the Pacific Flyway,
remaining riparian corridors and urban vegetation provide important
stopover habitat for migrants.

Intra-urban acoustic monitoring has not been widely applied in the
Central Valley, and so this project provides localized data for
conservation and urban greening initiatives.
